description: The birth pre-reg for a coltrane-flavored project. Emitted by problem-definer at the discover→define seam of project-bootstrap-v0. Sealed before DEVELOP begins (or marked unverified if user skips seal). The charter governs which preseed template is unrolled, which behavioral primitives are project-default, and which standards the project ships with.

predict.description: What this project predicts about itself. Falsifiable. Sealed.

kill.description: What would falsify the project's premise. Sealed.

apoha.description: What this project is explicitly NOT. Scope-bound. Sealed.

preseed_agents.description: Slugs of agents to ship in the scaffolded .coltrane/agents/. Includes the 4 universal phase-agents at minimum; template adds domain-specific ones.

preseed_standards.description: Slugs of standards to ship in .coltrane/standards/. Includes the 4 domain-protocol standards by default.

preseed_skills.description: Slugs of skills to ship in .coltrane/skills/. Includes coltrane-governance + apoha-discipline + rubric-loading + domain-specific skills.

seal_required.description: If true, DEVELOP refuses to run without a sealed charter (R1-style hard-gate). Default false = safe-prereg soft policy.

pre_reg_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical-JSON of {predict, kill, apoha}, computed at seal moment.

verdict.description: Set at DELIVER. UNVERIFIED = user skipped seal; verdict cannot be computed.
